method: From named neighbours in cataclysm_gog_r3a call_graph.csv, decompiled.c bodies compared with HomeworldSDL/gardens-of-kadesh HW1 functions (control flow, constants, string literals) and CET AISkirmish.h team layout; Cataclysm-only functions named cat_<subsystem>Verb. Ship file presence checked against shipHeaders 0x008b1938/shiptypeinfo 0x00889530 read from cataclysm.exe. Absent in Cataclysm: CloakGenerator.c (kCloakGenerator/tCloakGenerator have NULL CustShipHeader, no code), DDDFrigate.c and Drone (no ship type, no code), ResearchShip.c (no ship type; trResearchStation uses DefaultShipHeader). RepairCorvette.c code survives with an orphan RepairCorvetteHeader 0x008c6000 (no ship type) and refuelRepairShips used by ASF/Carrier/ResourceCollector. AIMoves.c: the whole aim* range 0x00406e90-0x0040e140 is already named (162/270); the other HW1 aim* functions are not in the binary. Dock.c is a Cataclysm rewrite (cat_dock*); only 6 helpers proposed.
